info.title: Parfumée API
info.description: API of the Parfumée shop. `/api/v1/shop` is used by the shop, `/api/v1/admin` by the back-office.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new session
post.description: A refresh token works once. The response carries a new one, which replaces it.

401.description: The refresh token is missing, unknown, expired or already used

post.description: Any account can sign in; the routes of the back-office then refuse an account without the editor or administrator role. Failed attempts are limited as on the shop, and the two sign-ins share the count.

get.description: Requires the editor role. One page of the categories, sorted by name unless told otherwise. Every filter is optional.

schema.title: Part of the name, whatever the case.
The children of this category only.
true: the top-level categories only.
Number of the page, from 1.
Maximum number of categories on a page.
Field to sort by. Categories with the same value are then sorted by id, so that pages never overlap.

200.description: One page of the matching categories

post.description: Requires the editor role. The slug is computed from the name. With parent_id, the category is filed under that top-level category.

404.description: The parent category does not exist

422.description: A field is invalid (with violations), or the parent is itself a child category (without)

put.description: Requires the editor role. The slug follows the name. Without parent_id, the category becomes a top-level one.

404.description: The category or its parent does not exist

422.description: A field is invalid (with violations), or the parent breaks the two levels (itself, a child category, or a category that holds others going under one)

delete.description: Requires the editor role. Only an empty category is deleted: one that holds a child category or a product (archived ones included) answers 409.

get.summary: Read my identity and my roles

get.description: Requires the editor role. One page of the catalogue, sorted by name unless told otherwise. Every filter is optional; without a status, the archived products are left out.

get.description: Requires the editor role. Whatever its status, archived included.

put.description: Requires the editor role. The slug follows the name. Without a status, the product keeps its own.

404.description: The product or the category does not exist

delete.description: Requires the editor role. The product leaves the shop but is kept, with the status "archived": the orders that sold it still read it. Archiving an archived product changes nothing.

post.summary: Add a picture to a product
post.description: Requires the editor role. JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB at most.

get.description: Requires the administrator role. One page of the accounts, sorted by email unless told otherwise.

200.description: One page of the matching accounts

post.description: The refresh token can no longer be exchanged for a new session. The JWT already issued stays valid until it expires (15 minutes): a front forgets it. An unknown or already revoked refresh token is accepted too, so that signing out never fails.
The number of attempts from one address is limited, whatever their outcome.
Failed attempts are limited per email and per address; a successful sign-in clears the count of its email.

BadRequest.description: The body is not valid JSON, or is not sent as `application/json`

Unauthorized.description: The token is missing, invalid or expired

Forbidden.description: The account does not have the required role

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource

ValidationFailed.description: A field is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many attempts from this address. Wait for the number of seconds given by `Retry-After`.

TotalCount.description: Number of items matching the filters, over all pages. Same value as `pagination.total`.

RetryAfter.description: Number of seconds to wait before trying again.

Bearer.description: The `token` returned by a sign-in or a token refresh. It lasts 15 minutes.
